title: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates /j/ na /nj/ and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: ji-a

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (to come by way of, a path or a way)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
board.say: Neno lipi lina maana ya "to come by way of"?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "jia" lina maana gani, na "njia" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "jia" ni to come by way of; "njia" ni a path or a way. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "to be full" ni "jaa". "njaa" lina maana ya "hunger".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "jaa" ni to be full, na "njaa" ni hunger.

listen_for: Biashara ya mtandaoni inakua kwa kasi.
misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /j/ na /nj/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nji-a.

checks.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Njoroge alijaa njaa njiani akanunua njugu kwa Juma.
